issuer: the Directorate General of Land Transport (Direction Générale des Transports Terrestres, DGTT)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on permis.transports.gov.mr, the DGTT's driving-licence platform (linked from the Ministry's site). Its table of categories gives category B (a vehicle of fewer than 9 seats) a minimum age of 18 and fiscal duties (droits fiscaux) of 1500, with no currency named; since the unit isn't stated (the ouguiya was redenominated in 2018), the fee is left null rather than read as one or the other. No term is stated, so it is null. A resident foreigner may drive on a foreign licence for a year and then transform it, paying the duty of the categories held; no list of countries is given, so no exchange list is held.
